name: Minutes
description: Local meeting memory that records and transcribes conversations into Markdown files and exposes them to AI assistants over MCP.
whatItDoes: Captures meetings and voice notes on the user's machine and saves each one as a searchable Markdown document. Coding and chat assistants can then recall past decisions and commitments from that archive.
howItWorks: A Rust CLI and desktop app handle recording and local transcription, writing notes into a meetings folder in the home directory. A companion MCP server, launched through npx, gives assistants tools to search and read those notes. A demo command shows the flow without a real recording.

requirements.name: macOS with Homebrew or Rust cargo
requirements.description: Install route for the app and CLI

requirements.name: Node.js
requirements.description: Needed to launch the MCP server with npx

install: claude mcp add minutes -- npx -y minutes-mcp
models: Local transcription; works with any MCP-capable assistant
